title: Hold a towing business authorisation
what: Hold a towing business authorisation before conducting a regulated towing business.

sources.title: Towing Services Act 2024 (WA)
sources.quote: A person commits an offence if the person — (a) conducts a regulated towing business; and (b) does not hold a towing business authorisation that is in force.
